capabilities: search local Obsidian notes from the sidebar
search remote ExMemo server content including bookmarks and quick notes
preview remote files before inserting them
filter searches by keywords, tags, time range, and directories
upload and download notes to keep devices in sync
extras: README warns users to back up vault data before using "Sync All Files" for the first time; remote features require installing and configuring a self-hosted ExMemo backend and registering a user; licensed under LGPL v3.0.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search only covers local notes, and keeping vault data consistent across devices requires an external sync path.

relations.evidence: obsidian-exmemo-client is an Obsidian plugin for ExMemo, providing note synchronization and intelligent retrieval features.

summary: Client for the ExMemo service that adds sidebar search across local and server data and syncs notes to the server for multi-device access.
